SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM apr50_bookmark WHERE apr50_appr_id = apr01_appr_id AND ( apr50_person_id = #{c.personId} OR apr50_public_yn = 'true' ) ) AS bookmark_yn , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , apr01_title AS title , apr01_receive_nm AS receive_name , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(relateInfo.*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(MIN(relate_nm), '') = '' THEN f_get_fund_nm2(MIN(relate_id), apr01_reg_date::date) ELSE MIN(relate_nm) END) || (CASE WHEN COUNT(relateInfo.*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 ' || (COUNT(relateInfo.*) - 1) END) END FROM ( SELECT apr03_fund_id relate_id , '' relate_nm FROM apr03_relate_fund WHERE apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id UNION ALL SELECT apr12_adv_id relate_id , adv02_manage_nm relate_nm FROM apr12_relate_adv INNER JOIN adv02_account ON adv02_account_id = apr12_adv_id WHERE apr12_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) relateInfo ) AS relate_display_name , ( CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '40' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#E33E31;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' WHEN apr01_status_cd = '99' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#4B81B9;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' ELSE '<' || 'b style=color:#404040;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' END ) AS status_name_bold , apr01_note AS note FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC LIMIT #{c.limit} OFFSET #{c.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1

WITH fund_count AS ( SELECT apr03_appr_id , MAX(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id)) AS fund_id , COUNT(DISTINCT apr03_fund_id) AS fund_cnt , STRING_AGG(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_cd, fnd01.fnd01_fund_cd), ', ') AS fund_code_all , STRING_AGG(f_get_fund_nm2(COALESCE(fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id, fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id), f_today()::date), ', ') AS fund_name_all FROM apr03_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id LEFT JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id GROUP BY apr03_appr_id ), adv_count AS ( SELECT apr12_appr_id , MAX(adv02_manage_nm) AS adv_nm , COUNT(DISTINCT apr12_adv_id) AS adv_cnt , STRING_AGG(adv02_manage_cd, ', ') AS adv_code_all , STRING_AGG(adv02_manage_nm, ', ') AS adv_name_all FROM apr12_relate_adv INNER JOIN adv02_account ON adv02_account_id = apr12_adv_id GROUP BY apr12_appr_id ) SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM apr50_bookmark WHERE apr50_appr_id = apr01_appr_id AND ( apr50_person_id = #{c.personId} OR apr50_public_yn = 'true' ) ) AS bookmark_yn , apr01_title AS title , CASE WHEN COALESCE(fc.fund_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(ac.adv_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(fc.fund_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(ac.adv_cnt, 0) || '건' END AS relate_display_name , ( CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '40' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#E33E31;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' WHEN apr01_status_cd = '99' THEN '<' || 'b style=color:#4B81B9;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' ELSE '<' || 'b style=color:#404040;' || '>' || f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) || '<' || '/b' || '>' END ) AS status_name , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr01_stamp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fund_count fc ON fc.apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN adv_count ac ON ac.apr12_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND (( ( fc.fund_id IN ( SELECT fnd08_fund_code_id FROM fnd08_org_auth WHERE fnd08_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' ) OR fc.fund_id IS NULL ) AND ( 'Y' = CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr04_emp_auth WHERE dcr04_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.personId} AND dcr04_retrieve_yn = 'false' ) != 0 THEN 'N' WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr03_org_auth WHERE dcr03_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND dcr03_retrieve_yn = 'true' ) != 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) AND ( ( apr01_link_cd IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys52_specific_menu_link l INNER JOIN sys50_specific_menu m ON l.sys52_specific_work_cd = m.sys50_specific_work_cd AND m.sys50_company_id = apr01_company_id INNER JOIN sys51_specific_menu_person p ON p.sys51_specific_menu_id = m.sys50_specific_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id = #{c.personId} WHERE l.sys52_company_id = apr01_company_id AND l.sys52_link_cd = apr01_link_cd ) ) ) ) OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) )) AND apr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.endDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT( f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') , apr01_title , fc.fund_code_all , fc.fund_name_all , ac.adv_code_all , ac.adv_name_all )) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC , apr01_appr_id DESC , apr01_title COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" ASC , apr01_status_cd , apr01_effect_date

SELECT x.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , x.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , x.apr01_status_nm AS status_name , x.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , x.apr01_inout_nm AS in_out_type_name , x.apr01_title AS title , f_emp_kor_nm(x.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , x.next_appr_nm AS next_appr_name , x.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , x.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_apr_id = x.apr01_appr_id ) > 0 THEN '송신' ELSE '' END AS mail_yn , x.my_approval_date AS my_approval_date , x.final_approval_date AS final_approval_date , x.apr01_note AS note FROM ( SELECT a.apr01_appr_id, a.apr01_status_cd, a.apr01_reg_date, a.apr01_effect_date, a.apr01_title, a.apr01_note, a.apr01_reg_emp_id, c.dcr01_class_tree_id, c.dcr01_class_tree_nm, b.apr04_appr_date AS my_approval_date, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', a.apr01_status_cd, #{c.companyId}, a.apr01_reg_date) AS apr01_status_nm, f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', a.apr01_inout_cd, #{c.companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS apr01_inout_nm, CASE WHEN a.apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN ( SELECT apr04_appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = a.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_status_cd = '20' ORDER BY LPAD(apr04_seq, 4, '0') DESC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS final_approval_date, CASE WHEN a.apr01_status_cd IN ('00','10','20') THEN ( SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN s.apr04_step_type_cd = '40' AND COALESCE(aa.apr07_stamp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN f_get_empTrans(d.apr10_second_emp_id, a.apr01_reg_date::date, 'title_nm')||' '||f_emp_kor_nm(d.apr10_second_emp_id) ELSE f_get_empTrans(aa.apr07_target_emp_id, a.apr01_reg_date::date, 'title_nm')||' '||f_emp_kor_nm(aa.apr07_target_emp_id) END FROM apr07_alt_appr aa WHERE aa.apr07_target_emp_id = s.apr04_step_emp_id AND a.apr01_reg_date BETWEEN aa.apr07_start_date AND aa.apr07_close_date LIMIT 1 ), f_get_empTrans(s.apr04_step_emp_id, a.apr01_reg_date::date, 'title_nm')||' '||f_emp_kor_nm(s.apr04_step_emp_id)) FROM apr04_appr_step s WHERE s.apr04_appr_id = a.apr01_appr_id AND s.apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('30') AND s.apr04_seq = ( SELECT MIN(s2.apr04_seq) FROM apr04_appr_step s2 WHERE s2.apr04_appr_id = a.apr01_appr_id AND s2.apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('30') AND s2.apr04_step_status_cd = '10' ) LIMIT 1 ) ELSE '' END AS next_appr_nm FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree c ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = c.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp d ON a.apr01_stamp_id = d.apr10_stamp_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.apr01_status_cd LIKE #{c.status} AND a.apr01_status_cd <= (CASE WHEN #{c.status} = '%' THEN '90' ELSE '99' END) AND ( CASE WHEN #{c.dateType} = 'reg' THEN f_trunc(a.apr01_reg_date) ELSE f_trunc(a.apr01_effect_date) END ) BETWEEN f_trunc(#{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND f_trunc(#{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND ( b.apr04_step_emp_id IN ( SELECT CAST(#{c.empId} AS numeric) UNION ALL SELECT apr07_target_emp_id FROM apr07_alt_appr WHERE apr07_alt_emp_id = #{c.empId} AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date ) OR b.apr04_appr_emp_id = #{c.empId} ) ) x WHERE ((#{c.aprYn} = 'false' AND x.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('30','40')) OR (#{c.aprYn} = 'true')) AND UPPER(CONCAT(x.apr01_title, x.dcr01_class_tree_nm, x.apr01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText})
AND x.dcr01_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree_down(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar), 15, '0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree_down b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree_down a )

SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd, emp00_company_id, apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr01_appr.apr01_inout_cd, emp00_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS in_out_type_name , apr01_appr.apr01_title AS title , f_cdnm('StatusCode', ics40_status_cd, ics40_company_id, ics40_reg_date) AS preconfirm_status_name , CASE WHEN ics40_confirm_msg IS NOT NULL THEN '있음' WHEN ics40_reg_emp_msg IS NOT NULL THEN '있음' ELSE '' END AS preconfirm_msg_yn_str , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_apr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) > 0 THEN '송신' ELSE '' END AS mail_yn , f_apr_get_title_nm( ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT apr04_appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ) ) AS recent_approval_name , ( SELECT apr04_appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ) AS recent_approval_date , apr01_appr.apr01_note AS note FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN emp00_trans_info ON apr01_reg_emp_id = emp00_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr01_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ics40_dcr_preconfirm ON apr01_appr_id = ics40_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp00_all_title = 0 AND emp00_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{c.regEmpId} AND apr01_status_cd LIKE #{c.status} AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND ((#{c.aprYn} = 'false' AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('30','40')) OR (#{c.aprYn} = 'true')) AND ( UPPER(CONCAT(apr01_title)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) OR UPPER(CONCAT(dcr01_class_tree_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) OR UPPER(CONCAT(apr01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) )
AND dcr01_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree_down(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar), 15, '0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree_down b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree_down a )
ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC

sql.if: AND dcr01_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree_down(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar), 15, '0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree_down b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree_down a )

mapper.sql: f_apr_get_title_nm( ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT apr04_appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ) ) AS recent_approval_name , ( SELECT apr04_appr_date FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_type_cd IN ('00','10','20') AND apr04_appr_date = ( SELECT MAX(apr04_appr_date) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) LIMIT 1 ) AS recent_approval_date

SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd, emp00_company_id, apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr01_appr.apr01_inout_cd, emp00_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS in_out_type_name , apr01_appr.apr01_title AS title , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_apr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) > 0 THEN '송신' ELSE '' END AS mail_yn , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_appr.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , , apr01_appr.apr01_note AS note FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step ON apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AND apr04_step_emp_id = #{c.regEmpId} AND apr04_step_type_cd = '30' INNER JOIN emp00_trans_info ON apr01_reg_emp_id = emp00_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp25_mypage_notice ON emp25_person_id = #{c.regEmpId} LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr01_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp00_all_title = 0 AND emp00_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_status_cd != '99' AND apr01_status_cd LIKE #{c.status} AND ( (COALESCE(emp25_appr_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND apr04_step_emp_id = apr04_step_emp_id) OR (COALESCE(emp25_appr_yn, 'false') = 'false' AND apr04_step_emp_id = #{c.regEmpId} AND apr04_step_type_cd = '30') ) AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND ((#{c.aprYn} = 'false' AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('30','40')) OR (#{c.aprYn} = 'true')) AND UPPER(CONCAT(apr01_title, dcr01_class_tree_nm, apr01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText})
ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC

SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_appr.apr01_status_cd, emp00_company_id, apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr01_appr.apr01_inout_cd, emp00_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS in_out_type_name , apr01_appr.apr01_title AS title , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr10_mail_history WHERE dcr10_apr_id = apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id ) > 0 THEN '송신' ELSE '' END AS mail_yn , , apr01_appr.apr01_note AS note FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr13_person_auth ON apr01_appr_id = apr13_appr_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN apr04_appr_step ON apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN emp00_trans_info ON apr01_reg_emp_id = emp00_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp25_mypage_notice ON emp25_person_id = #{c.regEmpId} LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr01_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp00_all_title = 0 AND emp00_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr13_person_id = #{c.regEmpId} AND apr01_status_cd != '99' AND apr01_status_cd LIKE #{c.status} AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND apr01_status_cd IN ('30','40') AND UPPER(CONCAT(apr01_title, dcr01_class_tree_nm, apr01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText})
ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC
SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_put_seal_emp_id) AS put_seal_emp_name , apr01_put_seal_dt AS put_seal_date FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}

SELECT CASE WHEN apr03_relate_fund_id IS NULL THEN apr01_appr_id ELSE apr03_relate_fund_id END AS relate_fund_id , apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , emp01_kor_nm AS reg_emp_name , apr01_title AS title FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = apr01_reg_emp_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN apr20_relate_ics ON apr20_appr_id = apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr01_appr_id = apr03_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr14_relate_ast ON apr01_appr_id = apr14_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( apr03_fund_id IN ( SELECT fnd08_fund_code_id FROM fnd08_org_auth WHERE fnd08_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' ) OR apr03_fund_id IS NULL ) AND apr20_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND emp01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN f_trunc(#{c.startDate}) AND f_trunc(#{c.endDate}) AND CONCAT( emp01_kor_nm , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{c.startDate}) , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, #{c.endDate}) , apr01_title ) LIKE #{c.searchText} ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC , apr01_title , apr01_status_cd , apr01_effect_date

SELECT A.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , A.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , A.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(A.apr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name_all_path , A.apr01_title AS title , A.apr01_receive_nm AS receive_name , B.sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM apr01_appr A LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file B ON A.apr01_appr_id = B.sys10_parent_id AND B.sys10_title_yn = 'true' LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp E ON A.apr01_stamp_id = E.apr10_stamp_id INNER JOIN apr03_relate_fund C ON A.apr01_appr_id = C.apr03_appr_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM fnd00_fund WHERE 1=1 AND fnd00_fund_id = #{c.fundCodeId} AND fnd00_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd00_fund_id, f_sysdate()) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM fnd00_fund WHERE 1=1 AND fnd00_real_fund_id = #{c.fundCodeId} AND fnd00_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd00_fund_id, f_sysdate()) ) D ON C.apr03_fund_id = D.fnd00_fund_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_appr_id IN ( SELECT apr01_appr_id FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth ON (dcr03_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth ON (dcr04_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.personId}) WHERE 1=1 AND dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT UNNEST(ARRAY[apr04_step_emp_id, apr04_appr_emp_id]) FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id UNION SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) ) AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND apr03_fund_id IN ( #{c.fundCodeId}, ( SELECT fnd01_fund_code_id FROM fnd01_fund_code WHERE fnd01_real_fund_id = #{c.fundCodeId} ) ) ) ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC

SELECT A.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , A.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , A.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , A.class_tree_nm_allpath AS class_tree_name_all_path , A.apr01_title AS title , A.apr01_note AS note , B.sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM ( SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date , apr01_appr.apr01_title , apr01_appr.apr01_note , apr01_appr.apr01_stamp_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(apr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_nm_allpath FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr14_relate_ast ON apr14_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr14_ast_id = #{c.astClassTreeId} AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND '1' = #{c.searchType} /* 1:연결종목으로만 조회 */ UNION SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_reg_date , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date , apr01_appr.apr01_title , apr01_appr.apr01_note , apr01_appr.apr01_stamp_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(apr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_nm_allpath FROM apr01_appr , apr03_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd08_org_auth ON ( fnd08_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND fnd08_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' ) , fnd10_book WHERE apr01_appr_id = apr03_appr_id AND apr03_fund_id = fnd10_fund_code_id AND fnd10_std_date = f_get_biz_date(apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date::date, '-1') AND fnd10_ast_class_tree_id = #{c.astClassTreeId} AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND '2' = #{c.searchType} /* 2:연결펀드의 운용종목으로 조회 */ ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file B ON A.apr01_appr_id = B.sys10_parent_id AND B.sys10_title_yn = 'true' LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp E ON A.apr01_stamp_id = E.apr10_stamp_id WHERE UPPER(apr01_title||class_tree_nm_allpath||apr01_note) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{c.searchText})||'%' AND apr01_appr_id IN ( SELECT apr01_appr_id FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth ON (dcr03_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth ON (dcr04_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.personId}) WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_status_cd = '30' /* 30:결재완료 */ AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR ( #{c.personId} IN ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id UNION SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) ) )

SELECT apr03_fund_id AS fund_id , COALESCE(fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd02.fnd02_fund_nm) AS fund_name FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN apr03_relate_fund ON apr03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02 ON ( fnd02.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND fnd02.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = apr03_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= apr01_reg_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd01_fund_code fnd01_r ON fnd01_r.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd02_fund_info fnd02_r ON ( fnd02_r.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND fnd02_r.fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info x WHERE x.fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01.fnd01_real_fund_id AND x.fnd02_work_date <= f_today() ) ) WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId}
SELECT apr12_adv_id AS adv_id , adv02_manage_nm AS manage_name FROM apr12_relate_adv a INNER JOIN adv02_account b ON a.apr12_adv_id = b.adv02_account_id WHERE apr12_appr_id = #{apprId}

SELECT (ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) AS appr_id , org_nm AS apr_org_name , person_nm AS apr_person_name , SUM(genCnt ) AS gen_cnt , SUM(icsCnt ) AS ics_cnt , SUM(genCnt + icsCnt ) AS total_cnt , SUM(procGenCnt ) AS proc_gen_cnt , SUM(procIcsCnt ) AS proc_ics_cnt , SUM(procGenCnt + procIcsCnt ) AS proc_total_cnt , SUM(unProcGenCnt ) AS un_proc_gen_cnt , SUM(unProcIcsCnt ) AS un_proc_ics_cnt , SUM(unProcGenCnt + unProcIcsCnt) AS un_proc_total_cnt FROM ( SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) person_nm , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') org_nm , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_cd') org_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END genCnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END icsCnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) = 0 AND apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END procGenCnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) != 0 AND apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END procIcsCnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) = 0 AND apr01_status_cd != '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unProcGenCnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) != 0 AND apr01_status_cd != '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unProcIcsCnt FROM apr01_appr LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) ics_cnt , apr20_appr_id FROM apr20_relate_ics GROUP BY apr20_appr_id ) ics ON apr20_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /* (40:반려/99:임시저장) */ AND apr01_effect_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE} ) apr WHERE org_nm LIKE #{c.orgName} AND person_nm LIKE #{c.personName} GROUP BY org_cd, org_nm, person_nm ORDER BY org_cd, person_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , apr01_doc_type_nm AS doc_type_name , class_tree_nm_allpath AS class_tree_name_all_path , apr01_title AS title , apr01_org_nm AS apr_org_name , apr01_person_nm AS apr_person_name , apr01_status_nm AS status_name FROM ( SELECT apr01_appr.apr01_appr_id , apr01_appr.apr01_effect_date , apr01_appr.apr01_title , (CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics_cnt,0) = 0 THEN '일반' ELSE '내부통제' END) AS apr01_doc_type_nm , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS apr01_status_nm , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS apr01_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(apr01_reg_emp_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_cd') AS apr01_org_cd , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS apr01_person_nm , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_nm_allpath FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON dcr01_class_tree_id = apr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) ics_cnt , apr20_appr_id FROM apr20_relate_ics GROUP BY apr20_appr_id ) ics ON apr20_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /* (40:반려/99:임시저장) */ AND ( ( #{c.statusCode} = 'true' AND apr01_status_cd = '30' ) OR ( #{c.statusCode} = 'false' AND apr01_status_cd != '30' ) OR ( #{c.statusCode} = '%' ) ) AND apr01_effect_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{c.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE} ) a WHERE apr01_doc_type_nm LIKE #{c.docType} AND apr01_org_nm LIKE #{c.orgName} AND apr01_person_nm LIKE #{c.personName} ORDER BY apr01_effect_date , apr01_doc_type_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc , apr01_org_cd , apr01_person_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , a.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , a.apr01_effect_date AS effect_date , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name_all_path , a.apr01_title AS title , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', a.apr01_status_cd, #{c.companyId}, a.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree b ON a.apr01_class_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN emp01_person e ON a.apr01_reg_emp_id = e.emp01_person_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{c.regEmpId} AND apr01_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.endDate} AND apr01_link_cd IN ( SELECT sys09_code FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'PreProvideRcvType' AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) ) ) ORDER BY apr01_reg_date DESC, apr01_appr_id DESC
